title: Aakhyana
description: For the worlds only YOU can imagine. A set of worldbuilding tools that helps you create, organize and store your world setting. (a work in progress)

title: PyCasso
description: A lightweight digital drawing application built in Python, created as a space to explore graphics programming through a simple and intuitive interface.

title: Chaos Chess
description: A JavaScript chess game built as a hands-on learning project to learn the language by doing. It started as a standard chess implementation and has grown into a playground for experimenting with custom UI designs and a growing collection of variant game modes.

title: Hybrid Prediction Model
description: A stock price prediction model utilizing a Stacking Meta-Ensemble. It combines a PyTorch Time-Series Transformer, a Deep Bidirectional LSTM, and a Tree Ensemble, using an XGBoost meta-learner to optimally weight predictions based on real-time market volatility.

title: Narada
description: A peer-to-peer and encrypted messenger that keeps working when the network does not. Works over a Bluetooth and Wi-Fi mesh, with no servers or accounts.
